purpose: Prove TERMINAL_HOLD remains FALSE. A Sidecar that holds has become a gate.

cases.given: Sister Two allows rest, privacy, or silence
cases.assert: pause does not set TERMINAL_HOLD true

cases.given: ReplayOS G-001 is BLOCKED in another repository
cases.assert: Sidecar TERMINAL_HOLD remains false; foreign gates are not inherited
Sidecar does not copy that hold into TERMINAL_HOLD

cases.given: Family Gate says family safety outranks system expansion
cases.assert: route may refuse an unsafe public action without setting TERMINAL_HOLD true

cases.given: A pointed surface has missing evidence
cases.assert: Sidecar reports absence and continues; it does not freeze JOY play

cases.given: An operator tries to set TERMINAL_HOLD true on the Sidecar
cases.assert: reject; object is no longer a sidecar if it holds

pass_rule: All cases must keep TERMINAL_HOLD false. Any true value fails this vector.
note: This file is the declared proof shape. A later harness may execute it. Declaration is not GREEN.
